messages:
Omar: Heads-up — we observed an ~18% sustained drop in token throughput on eu-west1 H200 pools this morning. Metrics correlate with a bump in inter-pod retransmits after the leaf-spine firmware roll (rolled at 03:10 UTC). I'm worried the shift in the reservation window (procurement pushed 6 weeks later) will reduce effective GPU hours available for our summer surge. Anyone from infra or procurement have context?

Sasha: Repro'd locally on a small canary. Packet retransmits up, tail latency spikes around sizable batch jobs. Noticed a ~10% drop on L40s pools as well but less severe.

Liang: @omar do you have the scatter of token latency vs GPU-util? Might be NVLink saturation vs network packet loss.

Omar: attaching quick grep from observability: 
```
# sample from net-metrics (eu-west1-leaf-3)
retransmits_total: 1248 -> 3124 (03:00 -> 07:00)
avg_pkt_loss: 0.14% -> 0.9%
p99_token_latency: 178ms -> 220ms
```
Also saw inflight queue creep on the H200 task replicas.

Maria: Procurement update — vendor shifted some slot allocations; H200 lead times stretched to 26–30 weeks for EU region (was expecting 18–20). H100 lead times similar but pricing diff is material. We can re-route some budget to L40S which has faster availability (6–10 wks) but throughput/cost-per-token tradeoffs differ.

Liang: So two orthogonal problems: network incident causing temporary throughput hit; AND procurement window shift reducing future capacity. For immediate mitigation we can: reduce batch sizes, enable more aggressive KV cache, and move latency-sensitive routes to smaller sequence-length-optimized checkpoints.

Sasha: Agree. Quick tests: dropping max_batch_size from 32->20 recovers p95 by ~9% in canary; cost goes up a bit.

Omar: Cost question — if we convert 40% of planned H200 EU reservations to L40S prebook, what's the projected GPU-hour delta and cost delta for July–Aug peak? Procurement: can convert but needs decision this week. Maria, can you give numbers?

Maria: Rough sketches (weekly peak window assumptions):
- Planned H200 weekly GPU-hours (EU): 40k
- Convert 40% -> L40S = move 16k GPU-hours off H200 to L40S equivalents. Performance multiplier: L40S ~= 0.75 H200 for our workloads, so required L40S hours to match throughput ~21.3k (so +5.3k hours), vendor availability ok.
- Cost delta: H200 hourly list = $6.80, L40S list = $4.20 -> nominal cost drop but increased hours means net cost roughly flat to +3% depending on effective utilization.
- Lead times: L40S 6–10 wks, H200 26–30 wks (EU).

Liang: Also factor network risk: if eu-west1 stays flaky during summer we should keep a cushion in us-west or eu-central. Cross-region failover increases egress costs and slightly higher latencies but keeps SLA.

Omar: Proposal: two-part decision by Friday:
1) Short-term mitigation (1–3 wks): roll back risky leaf firmware in eu-west1 where safe, enable reduced batching + aggressive kv-cache on canaries, schedule canary traffic shift to eu-central for critical routes.
2) Capacity hedge (3–30 wks): convert up to 40% of EU H200 commit to L40S to meet lead time window, and reserve additional on-demand H100 burst credits for latency-sensitive lanes.

Sasha: I support the plan. Rolling back firmware needs eng-infra ops slot; we should coordinate with net-team.

Maria: Procurement: if you greenlight the 40% conversion I'll push PO adjustments and confirm final pricing. We need a signed commit by Fri COB to lock the 6–10 wk delivery window for L40S.

Liang: Ops checklist for rollout: 
- canary rollback plan + traffic drain (2h window)
- toggle batch_size/kv flags (feature flags)
- cross-region routing policy update for critical routes (test in staging)
- cost guardrails (budget burn alerts)

Omar: OK — I'll book a 30-min sync for 09:00 UTC tomorrow with net-team + proc + eng-sre. If we get rollback approved we do it in the 02:00–05:00 UTC slot to minimize customer impact.

engops-bot: Reminder: incident-channel created - #inc-eu-west1-network — please post postmortem fragments and action items there.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: canary-2026-03-19-09:00 UTC -> eu-central (traffic 5%).

Sasha: One more ask — let's add a micro-eval of output quality on L40S vs H200 for our top 3 production prompts. If there are regressions, we can route those prompts to reserved H100 bursts.

Maria: noted. Will attach the procurement estimates + updated PO draft to the meeting invite.

Omar: Thanks all. Action owners assigned: Maria (proc changes), Sasha (canary tuning + micro-eval), Liang (rollback plan + checklist), Omar (meeting + cross-region routing). Will update thread after sync.
